_notes.method: scripts/analyze_structures.py: splats projected into pixel boxes of the reference cameras, front-most depth band, median world position; widths = pixel extent x depth / focal. Rectilinear features measured in a garden-aligned frame rotated garden_deg about +Z (a = along the beds/pond, b = across) from 1-D histograms of timber-coloured or bright splats. Pots: circle fit to pale splats at rim height + radius percentiles per 5 cm z slice. Steps: median splat height binned along b over the step strip.
_notes.frame: World metres, Z up, origin on the paving under the table centre (data/frame.json). Hero camera looks toward -Y, so hero image right = -X.
_notes.uncertainty: Objects 5-8 m from the capture centre have sparse/noisy splats: positions +-5 cm (pots, steps, beds), +-10 cm (spheres, statue, far props), +-20 cm for children's toys and chairs (right_960 top, >7 m away). Hidden backs (pot backs, bed far boards) are assumed symmetric.
_notes.pots: Two pale cream terracotta planters with a diagonal lattice relief. Circle fits at z>0.45: left (a 0.696, b -3.762, r 0.253), centre (a -0.651, b -3.802, r 0.265). Radius per slice (r50): left 0.30 m:0.195 0.40:0.224 0.50:0.258 0.55:0.278. Base z from the lowest pale splats (0.13 / 0.17). Centre pot is partly hidden behind the tree trunk in the hero view. Lattice: ~6 diamonds across the visible front and ~4.5 rows in the hero -> 16 around, pitch 0.095 m, thin ridges (round 3; 14/0.11 thick read coarse, 22/0.075 read as texture). Detail round 10: geometric lattice displacement off (it beaded on the 144x56 mesh); the lattice is now thin ~2.5 mm ribs drawn per pixel in the Ceramic shader from stored pot-local coordinates, as a sharp bump.
_notes.steps: Concrete flight between the pots, 4 risers. Tread heights (hero picks + b-profile): 0.09, 0.15, 0.25, 0.33 at b -3.47..-3.7, -3.85..-4.1, -4.2..-4.55, -4.65..-5.1; lowest edge b -3.45 at z 0.05 (path). Width 0.80 (between pot rims). Top riser is brick (rgb 133,104,80). Round 3: top riser moved to b -4.80 (hero brick pick at b -4.83) and riser 3 to -4.25 after the overlay showed them ~15 px low in the hero. Detail pass: close_pots shows the top landing as two salmon-pink paving slabs (pick z 0.31-0.35, rgb ~170,130,115 lit) with a centre joint, not a brick riser; treads are mossy concrete with worn front edges and weed clumps in corners. Detail round 8: landing raised 1 cm (0.345, within the 0.31-0.35 pick range) and its front edge moved to b -4.77 so the eroded lip no longer intersects the ground part's terrace surface at the notch edge (b -4.80), which caused stepped z-fighting bands across the pink lip.
_notes.handrails: Black steel handrails. close_pots_1024 picks: front posts (1.526,-3.385) and (0.815,-3.622), back posts (1.807,-4.247) and (1.086,-4.447) i.e. 0.91/0.88 m straight back along -b, standing on the 0.33 landing; rails rise from the front post tops (z ~0.95) through the back posts and run on ~0.45 m beyond the frame top. Knuckle joints at the post tops (close view). Detail round 2: front post tops measured 0.81-0.86 in close_pots (the 0.95 hero value was the rising rail), so posts are 0.74/0.71 m above their bases and the rail rises 0.39 m to the back posts (rail slope 0.43 from the close/hero rail picks), steeper than the 0.23 m flight. Blue twine wrapped on the right rail's sloping section (close_pots/close_trunk), 14 wraps over its lower 40%.

Base z 0.019 so the centre is at 0.104 (0.97 r above the base).
_notes.terrace_seedlings: Seedlings/weeds on the soil terrace left and right of the steps; heights follow the ground part's terrace ramp (z 0.16 at b -3.6 to 0.30 at b -5.0, i.e. 0.1 m/m), which matches the scan profile. Density raised to 50-70 /m2 in round 7 (reference shows many small weeds); 35% are broad-leaved rosettes. Detail round 2: added the strip behind the landing (a -1.0..1.6, b -6.2..-4.85, z 0.31-0.34 from close_pots 'grass_back' pick) where the reference shows grass clumps on soil around the pallet. Round 3: the strip behind the landing is split so no plants grow through the pink landing slabs (a -0.33..0.47, b -4.8..-5.45). Round 16: a dense mixed weed patch at the right rail foot (a -0.62..-0.32, b -4.05..-3.5; close_pots x570-790 y500-780 shows multi-stem weeds over dark soil).
_notes.ground_contact: Round 4: every prop base checked by ray-casting the ground part (outputs/parts/structures.blend). Where the measured splat base sat above that surface (far props, black pots, lantern, can) the base was lowered to it so nothing floats; the white ball now rests on a stone plinth (rock seed 8) matching its measured z 0.23-0.39. Where the ground is higher than the scan (terrace z ~0.30 under the steps/pots, scan 0.09-0.25) objects keep the measured height and are partly buried - a ground-side fix.
